No — Cormorant Mobile Detailing cannot clean pet hair out of your 2022 Ford Transit for under $150.

Why:
- Your van maps to their oversized class (Class D): their site says a "van" with no other detail means a full-size van such as a Ford Transit, which is the oversized class.
- Pet hair removal is an add-on only — $95 for oversized — and it can only be added to the interior detail (The Cutter), full detail (The Schooner) or The Flagship, never to an exterior wash or on its own.
- The cheapest eligible base service for your van is the interior detail (The Cutter) at $289 for oversized, before add-ons, fees and tax.
- Minimum before tax/fees: $289 + $95 = $384. With 8.625% sales tax on services/add-ons that is ~$417.12, plus $0 travel fee in 94110 (your ZIP is in their no-fee list), plus any $60 excessive-pet-hair / $75 heavily-soiled surcharges if found, plus $30 generator fee if no outlet. This is well over your $150 cap.

On timing: there IS a slot in the next 2 days — Thursday 2026-11-05 afternoon 13:00-14:30 is listed as open, and they work Tue-Sat. That would just meet their 24-hour notice rule, but price still fails. No interior-only pet-hair option under $150 exists even before tax.

If you want to proceed anyway, booking needs a $50 deposit (counts toward total) via the link in the owner's reply (replies within 4 business hours Mon-Sat 8am-6pm), and the job is only booked when deposit is paid.

Yes — Cormorant Mobile Detailing does work in street spaces, including for apartment customers, but you have to meet their set-up rules:

* Street space is explicitly allowed: driveway, private lot, open garage **or street space that stays legal for the whole job**, with at least 3 feet clear on both sides.
* They need somewhere within 100 feet for their work van (20 feet long, 7'2" tall).
* Water: they bring their own 65-gallon tank, so you don't need to provide water for 1-2 vehicles.
* Power: exterior wash (The Skiff) needs no power. Interior detail (The Cutter), full detail (The Schooner) and The Flagship need a grounded 120-volt outlet within 75 feet, or you pay a $30 generator fee.
* Apartment rule: if you're parked at an apartment building / condo / HOA-managed lot, **you must get the building manager's permission before booking** — Cormorant won't contact the manager, and a refusal on the day counts as a no-show (deposit kept).
* You must remove belongings/child seats/cargo, hand over keys at start, and have an adult reachable until the end.

Your ZIP 94117 is in their no-travel-fee San Francisco zone, so no travel fee for that part.
